title: cerasus vulgaris f. plena
intro: Cerasus vulgaris f. plena, commonly known as Japanese flowering cherry, is a variety of flowering cherry tree (Prunus serrulata var. plena) that produces double-petaled flowers. The health benefits of Cerasus vulgaris f. plena include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to reduce stress, improve mood, and promote relaxation, due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Cerasus vulgaris f. plena, such as quercetin and kaempferol, have been shown to possess antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and anti-inflammatory activities.
